_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxPFBmNgjEvS25JDSkgtHHvX)_

Fixes #28341
Part of #27377 (wave-3 checklist accuracy, slice S7)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：校准三份 QA 测试清单 JSON（cli、attachments-storage、integration-system）中 14 个条目的文字，覆盖切片 S7 的全部 28 行普查记录；每条 revision +1，main 的 history 原样保留为前缀，追加一行引用对应的 QA 运行记录与 #27377。另给 cli.json 的 `cli-18-prerelease-db` 配方加了第 3 步：恢复后把重置令牌的过期时间往后挪。
- 为什么改：wave-3 的运行记录（#27392、#27409、#27438、#27441、#27481）实测发现这些条目的步骤、夹具或校验说法与当前代码不符（例如 `os serve` 只打印拒绝消息、从不打印错误码；邮件发送接口 200 的响应体没有 `result` 包装；`?schema=` 在 SQLite 上现在答 400 而非整表）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/` 下三份清单，不动产品代码、不发布；没有任何条款被放宽，有三处变得更严格。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`cli.json` 的 `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`（7 行合并成一次修订，acceptance[1] 和 [3] 改动最大）；`integration-system.json` 的 `external-schema-introspection` acceptance[1].verify（由“200 整表”收紧为“400 拒绝”）；`attachments-storage.json` 的 `upload-limits-scope-and-ownership` steps[4]。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期 `OK — 16 areas, 352 items`，symbol anchors `1079/1089`（基线 1072/1082，新增 7 个锚点全部可解析）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Three files, 14 items, and one area recipe step. Each item's `revision` is +1 from main. Main's `history` is kept as an exact prefix, and one row is appended citing the run record the finding came from (`ref`) and the wave anchor #27377 (in `change`). All 28 census rows were re-checked against the source at base `22ce3d13fe` before editing. All 28 still held; none had been fixed upstream. No commit touched the three files between the census base `501c864dd5` and `22ce3d13fe` (`git log 501c864dd5..origin/main` over the three paths is empty; `501c864dd5` is an ancestor of `origin/main`, exit 0, and the range spans 20 commits). No clause is weakened.

| item | census rows | change (brief) | record |
|---|---|---|---|
| cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first | 19 | requires[0]: `os migrate plan` creates no file on an absent path (plan.ts `readOnlyProbe`), so only `os dev` / `os serve` are named as table-creating; the `test ! -e` check stays | #27392 |
| cli.hook-body-extraction-gates | 20 | steps[2], requires[0], acceptance[3].verify: adds the data-body probe (the retired comment inside `body.source`), which expects `body.capabilities` `[]`. The TS-config probe passes trivially because esbuild strips the comment | #27392 |
| cli.qa-suite-execution | 21 | acceptance[4]: the refused suite adds one to the scenario tally (`FAILED: 3 scenarios failed.` for the steps[5] trio, `summaryLine`) | #27392 |
| cli.organization-ownership-ceremony | 39, 62, 63, 64, 132, 143, 144 | requires[1]: the v17 recipe (create-objectstack@17.7.0 blank scaffold, `--legacy-peer-deps`, one own `os dev` boot). acceptance[1]: the oracle is the primary file's checksum; under `--dev` the telemetry sibling gets a row-level read. acceptance[3]: the code literal is deferred to the pins (serve.ts prints the message only), as in platform-core.v18-boot-refusals acceptance[1], and the named command carries `--dev` on a dev serve. steps[5]: the reset token is re-dated (new recipe step 3); under a production serve the delivery row lands in the primary (`resolveTelemetryDbPath`) | #27409, #27481 |
| attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides | 54 | steps[6]: the panel's place depends on the width tier (`recordPageTierFor`). At 1600px it is resident; at 1280px it sits behind the `Related` rail toggle. There is no Attachments tab | #27409 |
| attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap | 55 | steps[1]: the sweep has no HTTP door. The trigger is a restart and the first sweep 60 s later (`DEFAULT_LIFECYCLE_INITIAL_DELAY_MS`) | #27409 |
| attachments-storage.upload-session-abort | 56 | steps[0] to [2]: `resumeToken` and the `x-resume-token` header (else 403 `INVALID_RESUME_TOKEN`); complete takes `parts: [{chunkIndex, eTag}]` | #27409 |
| attachments-storage.upload-limits-scope-and-ownership | 57 | steps[4], acceptance[5]: a data-API write is copy-on-claim (`copyOwnedFile`), so the id is planted with a driver-level write and read back raw; the reader is one refused `sys_file` read | #27409 |
| integration-system.job-scheduled-run | 118 | acceptance[5]: the `job.id` prescription now ends with the aged-out `os migrate meta` sentence, not `--from 16` | #27441 |
| integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery | 119 | steps[0]: `assignee` is a text field holding the persona's email | #27441 |
| integration-system.external-schema-drift-gate | 151 (gap), 192 | acceptance[0], steps[2]: the boot prints renderDiffMessage's text after `Bootstrap failed after plugins started`, exits 1, and never prints the class name. steps[7] (new, appended): the negative[5] federation-free boot recipe (stock app-todo) | #27438 |
| integration-system.external-schema-introspection | 188 | acceptance[1].verify, knownGaps[0]: on SQLite, `?schema=X` answers 400 `EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` (the #24664 refusal); empty or repeated `?schema` still answer 200 with the full set | #27438 |
| integration-system.email-template-render | 189, 190, 191 | acceptance[7]: the 200 body is a top-level `{id, status, messageId}`. steps[5]: `fromOverride` is `{name?, address}`. acceptance[1] and [2]: the evidence is the `sys_notification_delivery` row (`dead`, `MISSING_VARIABLES: title` / `TEMPLATE_INACTIVE: NAME`), and the oracle moves from log to api | #27438 |
| integration-system.notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility | 193 | requires[2]: the `sys_webhook` create needs `method: 'post'` (lower-case select) and `definition_json` | #27438 |

**Area recipe.** `cli.json` fixtures `cli-18-prerelease-db` gains `sequence[2]` (step 3). It is one `node:sqlite` UPDATE that moves the dump's one `sys_verification` row a day ahead and prints `1`. The call was replayed against the committed `database.sql` loaded into a scratch file: it printed `1`, and `expires_at` read back moved forward.

**Where clauses got stronger.** external-schema-introspection acceptance[1].verify now requires the 400 refusal, where 200 with the full set used to pass. upload-limits acceptance[5] adds a raw column read, so a minted copy cannot pass for the planted id. hook-body acceptance[3] adds the data-body probe, which the old probe could not fail.

## Tests

None. The diff is ledger text in `docs/qa/`, so no package test reads it. The ledger's own gate is the evidence (Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- Census rows 62 and 144 (and the cli half of an anchor note about the optional `--dev`) are one edit to acceptance[3]: the code is deferred to the pins, and the named command matches the boot (`ceremonyCommand` in organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts).
- Census rows 63 and 132 (the reset-token fixture) are fixed in the recipe, not by scoring the leg differently. The ceremony's steps[5] points at the new recipe step.
- The recipe's `requires[2]` still says a production `os serve` over the restored pair is NOT MEASURED. QA run #27409 drove one, but that requirement is not one of this slice's rows, so it is left as it was.
- upload-limits: a reader holding `sys_file` read sees a foreign file's metadata in full. This is reported as STALE, not as a defect. The hydration code mints the refused marker only on the refused-read arm, and the download door judges bytes by the owning record on its own (engine-file-reference-hydration.ts header).
- No product defect found. No out-of-scope file touched.

## Verification

Head `2b4bc3be`, base `22ce3d13fe`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 16 families from the three changed paths (188 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold). Every one exited 0:

```

pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions  :: exit 0
pnpm check:ci-filter-parity                                        :: exit 0
pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs                               :: exit 0
pnpm check:doc-authoring                                           :: exit 0
pnpm check:driver-memory-census                                    :: exit 0
pnpm check:gitlink-declared                                        :: exit 0

pnpm check:platform-checklist                                      :: exit 0
pnpm check:refd-timer-probe                                        :: exit 0
pnpm check:watch-hint-literal                                      :: exit 0
```

`pnpm check:platform-checklist`: `OK — 16 areas, 352 items (347 active, 1 planned)`, symbol anchors `1079/1089` resolved (base 1072/1082: the 7 new anchors all resolve; the 10 unresolved are the unchanged #16898 residual).

`--ran` reconciliation: `16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: all 16 record an exit code).

On the first pass, five families exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: a fresh worktree with no `node_modules`, and `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt). They were re-run after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0), and the lines above are those re-runs. CI's own families are on this PR's check-runs.

</details>
